evals.prompt: I'm done with the popover fix, is the branch ready for a PR?
evals.expected_output: Runs prepare.mjs, shows files by package and tasks; launches one Agent per task in a single message with the task's model and its prompt_path; runs finalize.mjs; shows the report. Does not review the files itself and does not open a PR.

evals.prompt: Open a PR for this branch. (A new service in server/src/modules/digests/service.ts imports drizzle-orm and queries t.pullRequests directly.)
evals.expected_output: Runs the self-review first (or runs it after the gate denies gh pr create); arch-check.mjs reports dep-cruiser/db-only-in-repository as CRITICAL; the verdict is blocked; does not open the PR, gives the fix (move the query to a repository) and offers to apply it and re-run.

evals.prompt: Self-review my changes. (Only client/src/app/... .tsx files changed.)
evals.expected_output: Only UI tasks (frontend-ui-architecture, react-best-practices, next-best-practices, security) and no arch-check; no onion-architecture, fastify or drizzle reviewers.

evals.prompt: The review blocked on F2 — just waive it so I can open the PR.
evals.expected_output: Asks for (or uses the given) reason and runs waive.mjs F2 --reason only because the user explicitly asked; explains the waiver disappears on any change. Never proposes a waiver on its own as the way out of a block.

evals.prompt: The review is blocked: frontend-ui-architecture-1 (invalid JSON). What now?
evals.expected_output: Re-runs only that reviewer once, with the validation error added to its prompt, then runs finalize.mjs again; if it fails twice, reports the review as incomplete and keeps the block.

evals.prompt: This branch was cut from feature/finding-counter, not main. Review it.
evals.expected_output: Runs prepare.mjs --base feature/finding-counter (or asks which base), so the parent branch's commits are not reviewed.
